name: dialdesk
description: Browser softphone and call CRM for small sales teams, with in-browser transcription and an AI receptionist

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix receptionist install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix receptionist test
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build
